messages.subject: For Philip Hoare | Infrastructure, government relations and social-value leadership
messages.body:
Dear Balfour Beatty Press Office,

Please place this executive introduction before Mr. Philip Hoare, Group Chief Executive, where appropriate.

Major infrastructure programmes depend on disciplined delivery, trusted public-sector relationships, community confidence and measurable social value. Those priorities closely match my current executive responsibilities.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My mandate spans government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate affairs, strategic partnerships and executive advisory across complex resource and infrastructure matters.

I would welcome a senior conversation regarding roles where this combination of government relations, social-performance leadership and cross-functional execution could support Balfour Beatty. My attached CV has been tailored specifically to Balfour Beatty.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department | AGM Inc.
